Dear all,

some announcements of stats workshops by Mike Meredith and colleagues. They run excellent workshops, highly recommended !

Best regards  ---- Marc
From: Michael Meredith [stats...@gmail.com]
Sent: 30 September 2018 17:18
Subject: Stats Boot Camps and other training opportunities

Greetings everyone,

We ran a Boot Camp in Thailand in August and are now in Nepal; both Boot Camps were fully booked. We also ran a specialist "Bayes with JAGS" workshop in Bhutan in September. The following workshops are open for applications:

 = A Boot Camp in Germany 11-22 February 2019 has just been announced, where BCSS is partnering with the University of Goettingen. The deadline for applications is 10 October.

 = There are still places of available at our Boot Camp in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, 7-18 January 2019.

 = The Simulations workshop in Singapore 8-14 November 2018 still has a few places left.

Details of all these are on our home pages at bcss.org.my and bcssmalaysia.org.

Please pass on this information to friends and colleagues who may be interested.

Regards,  Mike

PS: If you don't want to receive these emails in future, just hit Reply and let me know.

--
Mike Meredith
Vice-chairman and Workshop Coordinator
BCSS
